messages:
Aisha R.: Noticed noisy duplicates in the audit export for route changes. Same actor, same policy, different event_id within 2s. Happened during a canary. Anyone else seen this?
Tom B.: Yep, we saw similar when console UI and infra webhook both emit on the same commit. Both producers are valid.
Jun L.: Can you paste the two lines? We need to decide whether backend should dedupe or UI should cluster.
Aisha R.: raw sample: ```{
  \"event_id\": \"evt_abc123\", \"actor\": \"u:789\", \"action\": \"policy.update\", \"meta\": { \"producer\": \"console\", \"policy\": \"p-42\" }
}
{
  \"event_id\": \"evt_def456\", \"actor\": \"u:789\", \"action\": \"policy.update\", \"meta\": { \"producer\": \"webhook\", \"policy\": \"p-42\" }
}```
Kelly B.: From product POV: we can't silently drop one. Users must be able to see both sources. Proposal: show clusters in Console timeline with an expand chevron to see raw events.
Tom B.: Backend compromise: emit an optional cluster_hint field so exporters can group without losing raw_event fidelity. Eg: `cluster_hint: sha256:...` computed from tenant-salted(actor+policy+action+time-window).
Nina V.: Important privacy note: salted hash still counts as pseudonymous data in EU. If legal requests come, we must provide a reversible mapping. How do we reconcile salt + reversibility?
Sam R.: Idea: keep mapping table (event_id -> actor) only in privileged bundle for legal exports. Default export keeps salted cluster_hint. Mapping bundle stored in a different S3 path, KMS-encrypted, and ACL-gated. Every download of that bundle gets a separate presigned link and an audit-bot entry.
audit-bot: action recorded: export_bundle_generated by Aisha R. (env:prod, id:exp_202603, mode:privileged)
Jun L.: Implementation notes: add optional top-level `cluster_hint` string and update manifest to include `pii_mapping_included: yes|no` and `pii_mapping_location: s3://...` when mapping included. Also add `export_mode: raw|clustered` in manifest. We'll bump schema to `#schema:route-audit.v2`.
Kelly B.: UX: timeline clusters by default, shows badge "N events" with sources shown on expand. Download modal: for compliance customers default `raw`, but allow a toggle "omit mapping bundle" to reduce exposure. Also show schema version and compatibility warnings for SIEM connectors.
Tom B.: Quotas: clustering in UI reduces perceived volume but we still bill tokens/events on raw emission. Need to be explicit in docs: UI clusters do not change billing or retention.
Nina V.: Also add a flag `dedupe_window_seconds` documented in manifest so downstream consumers know how we form cluster hints. We should run a sampling job to pick a safe default (30s?) before shipping.
Sam R.: Ops checklist: mapping bundles must be rotated keys, stored with separate KMS alias, and the download presigned URLs should be short lived. I'll add to runbook.
Jun L.: I'll open a PR against route-audit-proto with the optional fields and manifest changes. PR will reference sample NDJSON header `#schema:route-audit.v2` and a compatibility note.
Aisha R.: Can we also include a human-readable cluster_reason in the manifest when cluster_hint is present? Eg `cluster_reason: multiple_producers_same_actor_policy_close_window`. That helps legal reviewers.
Kelly B.: Good call. UI can surface that.
Tom B.: One more thing: telemetry. We should emit metric `audit.clustered_events` and `audit.raw_event_count` so we can measure signal/noise ratio per-tenant. Planning to alert if a tenant has >90% clustered events for a week.
Jun L.: I'll add metrics.
Sam R.: I'll schedule the sampling job to calculate inter-event deltas by policy and actor. ETA 48h.
Nina V.: I'll draft the privacy snippet for the export docs and ping legal.
Aisha R.: Timeline: Jun/ Tom implement fields + sampling job this week, Sam ensures S3/KMS/runbook, Kelly updates modal and timeline, Nina privacy text. Ping here when PRs land and we'll review.
Kelly B.: Figma mock names: audit/clustered-timeline-v1.
Jun L.: PR: will post link here when ready.
Aisha R.: Thanks everyone. :rocket:
